description: Customer-visible service setup latency and blockers, projection queue capacity, observer health, leader ownership, Kubernetes API pressure, and rollout state.

panels.description: Request acceptance to first successful SetupComplete. -1 means the telemetry is not deployed or no successful setup exists in the rate window.
panels.title: User setup p95

panels.description: Authorization to first successful SetupComplete. External approval time is excluded. -1 means no observation is available.
panels.title: Platform setup p95

panels.description: Successful initial setup attempts in the selected dashboard range. Zero is valid only while observer telemetry is present.
panels.title: Completed setups

panels.description: Fraction of discovered service-catalog controller targets that VictoriaMetrics is scraping successfully.
panels.title: Replicas scraped

panels.description: End-to-end p95. The -1 fallback keeps the panel explicit before telemetry rollout or during an idle range; use Observer health before interpreting it.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_class, clock) (rate(service_catalog_setup_duration_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]))) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(-1), "service_class", "none", "", ""), "clock", "no observations", "", "")

panels.title: Setup latency by service class and clock

panels.description: Persisted setup attempts that have not reached first completion. Missing or unhealthy observer telemetry renders Telemetry unavailable.
panels.title: In flight

panels.description: Unfinished attempts older than the initial 60-second objective.
panels.title: Overdue (>60s)

panels.description: Age of the oldest unfinished persisted setup attempt.
panels.title: Oldest unfinished

panels.description: Current unfinished attempts grouped by the first incomplete stage. -1 means coverage is unavailable, while a healthy empty observer reports a zero series.

targets.expr: sum by (blocking_stage) (service_catalog_setup_inflight) or label_replace(((max(service_catalog_setup_observer_healthy) == 1) * 0), "blocking_stage", "none", "", "") or label_replace((((max(service_catalog_setup_observer_healthy) == 0) * -1) or (absent(service_catalog_setup_observer_healthy) * -1)), "blocking_stage", "telemetry unavailable", "", "")

panels.title: Unfinished attempts by blocking stage

panels.description: Execution time for bounded projection phases. This does not include workqueue delay.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, phase) (rate(service_catalog_projection_phase_duration_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]))) or label_replace(vector(-1), "phase", "no observations", "", "")

panels.title: Projection phase p95

panels.description: Successful setup observations per interval. Zero means no completion was recorded; observer health shows whether coverage is trustworthy.

targets.expr: sum by (service_class, clock) (increase(service_catalog_setup_duration_seconds_count[$__interval])) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "service_class", "none", "", ""), "clock", "no completions", "", "")

panels.title: Setup completion volume by class

panels.description: Projects waiting in the projection queue. The selector spans the legacy location-binding and new location-projection controller names.
panels.title: Projection queue depth

panels.description: Time from enqueue to worker start. Zero means no queue-delay observations in the rate window.
panels.title: Queue delay p95

panels.description: Worker execution time after dequeue. Compare this with queue delay to distinguish capacity from slow reconciliation.
panels.title: Reconcile execution p95

panels.description: Active workers across the selected projection controller. Under elected projection, only the owner should process work.
panels.title: Active projection workers

panels.description: Queueing, execution, and the longest active worker. A growing queue delay with bounded work time indicates insufficient effective ownership or worker capacity.
panels.title: Queue delay and worker execution

panels.description: Outstanding projects and retry pressure. Both series use bounded controller names and carry no project labels.
panels.title: Projection queue depth and retries

panels.description: Whether all source caches needed to interpret setup state are synchronized on the projection owner. Missing data is explicitly unknown.
panels.title: Setup observer

panels.description: Seconds since the aggregate writer last completed a successful observation pass. -1 means it has never reported.
panels.title: Last successful observation

panels.description: Number of service-catalog controller targets currently scraped as up. This proves scrape reachability, not cache completeness.
panels.title: Controller targets up

panels.description: Exactly one replica should own the projection lease after rollout. -1 means this release has not exposed the distinct projection election.
panels.title: Projection leaders

panels.description: Exactly one primary controller manager leader is expected.
panels.title: Primary manager leaders

panels.description: Replicas holding any service-catalog manager election. Separate primary and projection managers may intentionally land on different pods.
panels.title: Leader-bearing replicas

panels.description: Sum of leader-election status across replicas for each manager name. Each active election should remain at exactly one.
panels.title: Election ownership by manager

panels.description: Time spent waiting for client-side rate-limit tokens. Zero means no waits were observed in the rate window.
panels.title: Client throttle wait p95

panels.description: Kubernetes API responses rejected for server-side throttling.
panels.title: HTTP 429 rate

panels.description: Kubernetes REST round-trip latency. This excludes client rate-limiter wait. -1 means the histogram is unavailable on the deployed release.
panels.title: API request p95

panels.description: Controller REST traffic grouped by bounded HTTP response code. Use this to correlate retries and 429s with setup delay.
panels.title: Kubernetes API request rate by response code

panels.description: P95 REST round-trip latency grouped by method label (`verb`). Client-side limiter waits are shown separately.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, verb) (rate(rest_client_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="services-system/services-controller-manager"}[$__rate_interval]))) or label_replace(vector(-1), "verb", "telemetry unavailable", "", "")

panels.title: Kubernetes API request latency by method

panels.description: Container restarts during the selected range. Leadership loss intentionally terminates the process, so correlate restarts with election changes.
panels.title: Controller restarts

panels.description: Ready service-catalog controller-manager pods.
panels.title: Ready controller pods

panels.description: Age of the youngest scraped controller process. A reset identifies rollout or restart timing.
panels.title: Process age (youngest)

panels.description: Current replica count by immutable image reference. Mixed series identify a rollout in progress.
panels.title: Running replicas by image

title: Service Catalog Setup
